name: Tsuruhime
source:
A rookie pirate who joined the Libertalia Pirate Crew to get away from her hometown and to stand alongside her childhood friend, Murakami Takekichi.

She keeps a chicken on her head... its name is Washigatou-san.

"Personally, I think this journey can be called a grand adventure!"
translation:
